title: Call it in parallel with Munk
subtitle: {count} sandbox cases waiting for your call. You see what Munk saw — but not what he chose, until you press Send.
empty: No open sandbox cases right now. Come back once Munk has decided more alerts.
footnote: Sandbox cases are hrv_alerts Munk has already decided. Your call is compared with his — the rolling mean over the last 50 sandbox cases drives the promotion gate (target: ≥80%).
reasoningPlaceholder: Why that call? — short note so Munk sees your thinking.

held.title: Munk needs to look at this one first. You don't need to do anything — your note is waiting for review.

revealed.footnote: Comparison saved. You move toward the next-50 mean.

live.title: Your assigned members
live.subtitle: {count} open alerts on members you co-coach. Your call closes the queue.
live.empty: No open alerts on your members right now. Good work — or a quiet morning.
live.footnote: Live calls are saved as coach_reviews (mode=live). Munk spot-checks via /coach/co-coaches.
live.decisionHeader: Your call — this is the final decision
live.reasoningPlaceholder: Short note for the member or Munk's audit trail.

tree.title: Learn to coach like Munk
